title: Regression Discontinuity and the Price Effects of Stock Market Indexing
one_line: Using the Russell 1000/2000 cutoff (stocks just below rank 1000 join the Russell 2000 and get index buying), the authors find price effects for both additions and deletions, isolating indexing demand from news.

findings.statement: Price effects for Russell 2000 additions and deletions around the cutoff.

reported_results.headline: Using the Russell 1000/2000 cutoff (stocks just below rank 1000 join the Russell 2000 and get index buying), the authors find price effects for both additions and deletions, isolating indexing demand from news.
